Tender for supply of textile backpacks with “Make in India” logo



## Tender for supply of textile backpacks with “Make in India” logo

**Tender for supply of textile backpacks with “Make in India” logo**

**WAS/COM/205/6/2019**

1\. Bids are invited in a sealed envelope for supply of 200 textile bags with “Make in India” logo as per specifications mentioned below:-

2\. The bags should be made in India and carry the ‘Made in India’ tag

3\. Dimension: Capacity is 15 inches, \[46X35X16 Centimeters\]

Weight: 0.65 Kilogram

Material: Waterproof Polyester, with one main metal zipper for the opening and a small zipper for the front pocket

Color: Upper Half black and below half grey in color

4\. The “Make in India” logo will be embroidered prominently \[4 inches\] on the front of the bag (as per logo attached)

5\. Please mail and email the bid with complete specifications of the backpack, unit price, shipping charges and total cost to the following address:

1\. Embassy of India

Commerce Wing

Dr. Shyam Prasad, First Secretary (Commerce)
